task.name: place_knife_in_drawer
task.description: Use the right arm to place the green plastic knife into the open top drawer.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the green plastic knife.
2. Grasp the green plastic knife with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the open top drawer.
4. Release the gripper to place the green plastic knife into the open top drawer.
